label: Level
description: The unit's level as the 1984 volume prints it: pays (the country), region, ville (city) or sous-region (sub-region). A ville and a sous-region are of the same level; a region is the sum of both

label: Region
description: The 1984 region a unit lies in; empty for the country and the regions themselves

label: Unit
description: The unit's name as printed in the 1984 volume

label: Total
description: Resident population, July 1984 census; men plus women

label: Table
description: The table of the Totaux definitifs the row was read from: T-01 or T-02

label: Printed page
description: The page number printed in the volume

label: Read from
description: How the row was read: the scan's text layer or its page image, and any correction made
